description: Bihar STET Computer Science Practice Set 2

questions.questionText: Which operator is used for logical AND in C?
questions.explanation: The && operator is used for logical AND in C.

questions.questionText: Which sorting algorithm repeatedly compares adjacent elements?
questions.explanation: Bubble Sort repeatedly compares adjacent elements and swaps them when required.

questions.questionText: Which protocol is commonly used to transfer web pages?
questions.explanation: HTTP is commonly used for communication between web browsers and web servers.
